questions.question: Find the difference between the sum of prime digits and the sum of composite digits in the number 397801.
questions.solution:
Number = 397801

Prime digits in the number = 3, 7

Composite digits in the number = 8, 9

Difference = (Sum of composite digits) - (Sum of prime digits)

= (8 + 9) - (3 + 7)

= 17 - 10

= 7

Hence, **"7"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A is sitting second to the right of D, who is third to the left of B. If C is NOT sitting with D, then who is sitting between E and F?
questions.solution:
According to the given information :

A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) A is sitting second to the right of D, who is third to the left of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7080e116754bc84bcacc6e04167cd05ea750b24e702858589968e6bd05ab747d.png] 

2) If C is NOT sitting with D then C will be sit to the just right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8af419058ce6d9c4903c46d38b251d220ff688207217ae9252bc7c9787dcb0d.png] 

Nothing is mentioned about E and F then there may be two cases.

**Case 1 : **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a6c9ff4fbe6e2c19fba865c871e9808e0cae75148aced52268f1e667a582451.png] 

**Case 2 :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c204ad67f38e6f5a0d8d0de282c4b057ced63987d4e18142c056c2178860339.png] 

So,** from both cases :**

**'D' is sitting between E and F.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "D".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11c8ec20d6f641996d28242094b953311dd708f91066cf1ea9cde3d1aa519058.png] 

Who is used for the second person in a connecting statement.

For example, in the above question : 

A is sitting second to the right of **D, who** is third to the left of B.

Here, who is used for **D** and not for **A**.

Thus D is third to the left of B.

questions.question: Today is John's birthday. After one year, he will be twice the age of 8 years ago. How old is John today?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

Let John's present age be "X".

8 years ago John's age was "X - 8".

After one year John's age will be "X + 1".

Here, after one year, he will be twice the age of his age 8 years ago.

So, X + 1 = 2(X - 8)

X + 1 = 2X - 16

Taking X right side,

2X - X = 1 + 16

X = 17

Hence, **John's present age is "17 years"**.

questions.question:

We have number "3" only in dice 1.

So, **here number "3" from dice 1 and number "4" from dice 4 are opposite to each other.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"4"**.

questions.question: Johnson's current age is 1/5 of his father's age. Five years earlier, Johnson's father's age was 2 years more than 8 times Johnson's age. What is the present age (in years) of Johnson and his father respectively?
questions.solution:
Given, Johnson's current age is 1/5 of his father's age.

Let Johnson's present age be x

⇒ Johnson's father's present age = 5x

Given, five years earlier, Johnson's father's age was 2 years more than 8 times Johnson's age.

Johnson's age five years earlier = x - 5

Johnson's father's age five years earlier = 5x - 5

5x - 5 = 8 (x - 5) + 2

5x - 5 = 8x - 40 + 2

8x - 5x = 40 - 5 - 2

3x = 33

x = 11

Hence, Johnson's present age = x = 11 years.

Johnson's father's present age = 5x = 5 × 11 = 55 years.

Hence, the correct answer is **"11, 55"**.

questions.question: Select the option in which the two numbers share the same relationship as that shared by the given number - pair. (11, 143)

First Number = 11

Second Number = First number × (First number + 2)

= 11 × (11 + 2)

= 11 × 13

= 143 = 143

Checking the options:

= 18 × (18 + 2)

= 18 × 20

= 360 ≠ 93

**= 17 × 19**

**= 323 = 323**

3) (24, 216)

= 24 × 26

= 624 ≠ 216

4) (5, 39)

questions.question: If every vowel in the word 'JABALPUR' is changed to its next letter in the ENGLISH alphabet and every consonant is changed to its previous letter, then what will be the fourth letter from the right?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b06c01734f8aa4c011a0a36a57e3bea6aebf56189f0aedd590f9d0d65a852ad3.png] 

If every **vowel** in the word 'JABALPUR' is changed to its **next** letter in the ENGLISH alphabet.

'J**A**B**A**LP**U**R' → J**B**B**B**LP**V**R

If every **consonant** is changed to its **previous** letter.

'**J**A**B**A**LP**U**R**' → **I**A**A**A**KO**U**Q**

Then, we get :

'JABALPUR' → IBAB__**K**OVQ__

So, **K will be the fourth letter from the right.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"K".**

questions.question: Khushi is three years older than Pihoo but two years younger than Tushar. Tushar's age is five years more than thrice of Vatshala's age. If Vatshala is five years old, then what is the age of Pihoo?
questions.solution:
Given that,

Vatshala's age = 5 years

Tushar's age = 3(Vatshala's age) + 5

Tushar's age = 3 × 5 + 5 = 15 + 5

Tushar's age = 20 years.

Khushi is two years younger to Tushar.

Khushi's age = (Tushar's age) - 2

Khushi's age = 20 - 2 = 18 years.

Also, Khushi is three years older than Pihoo.

Khushi's age = (Pihoo's age) + 3

Pihoo's age = Khushi's age - 3

Pihoo's age = 18 - 3

**Pihoo's age = 15 years.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"15 years".**

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :

**Second number = (First number)² - (First number)**

For 18 : 306,

18² -18 = 324 -18 = 306.

Similarly,

**For 19 : ?,**

**19² - 19 = 361 - 19 = 342.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"342".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some girls are educated.

2. Educated girls prefer small families.

**Conclusions:**

I. All small families are educated.

II. Some girls prefer small families.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I nor II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follow :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d11a59304ea7a161220d17499b66a199bf0640ec07ff277b257f6775c5b2a8b.png] 

**Conclusions :**

I. All small families are educated → False** **(Some small families are educated but being all small families educated is just a possibility and not definite).

II. Some girls prefer small families → True** **(Educated girls prefer small families. Some girls are educated. Hence, some girls prefer small families).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusions II follows".**
